YOUR PARTS DESK. IN YOUR POCKET.

Ford Parts Desk
for Android.

Search thousands of source-backed Ford base numbers. Grouped part families, quick lookups, saved parts and a job desk are available offline from the first launch.

Download a signed Android release ↗

Choose the versioned APK under the release's Assets. Unsigned and debug workflow artifacts are for testing. Install newer signed Ford Parts Desk versions over this app to retain your workspace.

Android 8.0 or newer with a current Android System WebView.

Keep your existing workspace

The new app identity installs separately. Keep the previous app installed until you have restored and checked your workspace.

  1. In the previous app, open Tools → Back up my workspace and save the JSON file somewhere you can find.
  2. Install the signed APK and open Ford Parts Desk.
  3. Open Tools → Restore a workspace, choose the backup and review the replacement confirmation.
  4. Check your saved parts, notes, jobs and vehicle history. Sign in to Snap-on separately on this app.

Backup files carry the workspace data, so their old filename does not need to be changed. Snap-on credentials and cookies do not transfer.

From base number to service part

Enter a full VIN or its last eight characters, confirm the complete vehicle, then use the guided catalog dropdowns and service-part cards. Tap View diagram whenever you want the current illustration with zoom controls. EPC access and new VIN decodes need internet. Changing the VIN flags earlier selections for rechecking.

Use it in your browser

The same workspace works on a desktop, tablet or phone. Browser data and Android data are separate.

Open parts workspace ↗

Ford Parts Desk is an independent reference tool, not an official Ford electronic parts catalog. Base numbers identify part families, not exact vehicle fitment. Confirm the full service part by VIN. Coverage is broad but incomplete.
